title: Privacy Policy | Pixel One Visuals
metaDescription: Privacy policy of Pixel One Visuals: how we collect data, why we use it, how we protect it, and your rights to access, correct, and delete.
texts: This policy explains how personal data is collected, processed, and protected when using Pixel One Visuals services. We follow a data minimization principle and collect only what is required to deliver the service, while complying with applicable legal requirements in the Kingdom of Morocco, including the general framework for personal data protection.
Identity and contact data: name, email address, phone number.
Account data: sign in information and session management data.
Project data: order details, attachments, and execution-related notes.
Limited technical data: essential operational logs needed for security and performance improvement.
3) Legal basis and purpose of processing
Contract performance or pre-contractual steps: service delivery, order tracking, and handoff.
Legal obligation: retaining required records when legal or judicial requirements apply.
Legitimate interest: protecting the platform, preventing abuse, and improving service quality.
Consent: where explicit consent is required (such as future marketing communication, if applicable).

We do not sell your personal data. We may share only the minimum necessary with trusted technical providers (such as hosting, identity management, or email) solely to operate and secure the service. We may also disclose data when required by law or to protect our legal rights.

Some data may be processed on servers or cloud services outside your country of residence. In such cases, we apply reasonable contractual and organizational safeguards to ensure an appropriate level of protection consistent with applicable rules.

We retain data only for the period necessary to fulfill service purposes or legal obligations. Once the legitimate need ends, data is deleted or anonymized securely, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

We apply appropriate technical and organizational security controls, including access control, permission restriction, and protection against unauthorized access, alteration, or loss. However, no system is 100% secure, so users should follow good account security practices.

We use necessary technical cookies to operate the platform and improve user experience. If analytics or measurement tools are adopted in the future, this page will be updated with purpose and data categories.
Right to request access to your personal data.
Right to request correction or update of inaccurate data.
Right to request data deletion within legal and contractual limits.
Right to object to or restrict certain processing operations where legally available.
To submit a rights request, contact us using the same email linked to your account to simplify identity verification.

Our services are intended for business and professional activities. We do not intentionally collect minors' data. If we discover data related to a minor without proper basis, we will take deletion or restriction measures as required.
This policy may be updated when services or legal requirements change. The "Last updated" date is the official reference for the effective version. For inquiries or privacy requests:
This document is drafted in a strong operational format suitable for digital services, but it does not replace specialized legal review before final binding use in transactions or disputes.
